56845690.description: Osmyl tetra-ammine chloride (also known as osmyl tetramminochloride and tetraamminedioxoosmium chloride) is an inorganic chemical compound with the formula [OsO2 4]Cl2.

66610682.name: Privosegtor
66610682.description: Privosegtor is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Oculis Pharma for the treatment of optic neuritis.

71308282.name: Tetraphlorethol C
71308282.description: Tetraphlorethol C is a phlorethol-type phlorotannin found in the brown alga Ascophyllum nodosum. Chemically, it is a tetramer of 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene.

85397242.name: Cyclopentadienylindium(I)
85397242.description: Cyclopentadienylindium , C5H5In, is an organoindium compound containing indium in the +1 oxidation state.

91865978.name: 9-Borafluorene
91865978.description: 9-Borafluorenes are a class of boron-containing heterocycles consisting of a tricyclic system with a central BC4 ring with two fused arene groups.

101485562.name: Melitidin
101485562.description: Melitidin is a flavanone glycoside. Melitidin was discovered in bergamot orange juice and exhibits statin-like properties in preclinical research.

102004474.name: Masticadienolic acid
102004474.description: Masticadienolic acid is a naturally occurring terpenoid compound found in the resin of the mastic tree , particularly in the variety cultivated on the Greek island of Chios.

102144506.name: Α-Pyrrolidinooctanophenone
102144506.description: α-Pyrrolidinooctanophenone also known as PV9 — a central nervous system stimulant that exhibited properties of a neuroinflammatory agent.

118023034.name: Avapritinib
118023034.description: Avapritinib, sold under the brand name Ayvakit among others, is a medication used for the treatment of advanced systemic mastocytosis and indolent systemic mastocytosis.

129021946.name: BB-Cl-Amidine
129021946.description: BB-Cl-Amidine is an experimental drug which acts as a non-subtype selective, irreversible inhibitor of the enzyme peptidylarginine deiminase .

134871162.name: Cyclopentadienylchromium tricarbonyl dimer
134871162.description: Cyclopentadienylchromium tricarbonyl dimer is the organochromium compound with the formula Cp2Cr2 6, where Cp is C5H5.

135395450.name: NJK14047
135395450.description: NJK14047 is a drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase .

155884410.name: Rusfertide
155884410.description: Rusfertide, sold under the brand name Mimrylo, is a medication developed by Protagonist Therapeutics in partnership with Takeda for the treatment of polycythemia vera .

156836218.name: 5-Fluoro-EPT
156836218.description: 5-Fluoro-EPT (5F-EPT, 5-fluoro-N-ethyl-N-propyltryptamine) is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative related to drugs such as EPT and 5-MeO-EPT.

163191674.name: ADB-HEXINACA
163191674.description: ADB-HEXINACA (also known as ADB-HINACA and ADMB-HEXINACA) is a cannabinoid designer drug that has been found as an ingredient in some synthetic cannabis products, first appearing in early 2021.

166468730.name: 4-HO-NiPT
166468730.description: 4-HO-NiPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to psilocin .

172873722.name: MDMB-5'Br-4en-PINACA
172873722.description: MDMB-5'Br-4en-PINACA is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist that has been sold as a designer drug.

900000122.name: Albinterferon
900000122.description: Albinterferon is a recombinant fusion protein drug consisting of interferon alpha linked to human albumin.

900000250.name: Bavituximab
900000250.description: Bavituximab is a human-mouse chimeric monoclonal antibody against phosphatidylserine, which is a component of cell membranes that is exposed when a cell is transformed into solid tumor cancer cell or...

900000506.name: Copper naproxen
900000506.description: Copper naproxen is a chemical complex of Cu2+ chelated with the anti-inflammatory drug naproxen.

900000634.name: Do6a
900000634.description: Do6a is a venom peptide found in the venom of the Velvet ant .

900001018.name: Inovio COVID-19 vaccine
900001018.description: Inovio COVID-19 vaccine is a COVID-19 vaccine candidate developed by Inovio Pharmaceuticals.

900001146.name: Linear alkylbenzene
900001146.description: Linear alkylbenzenes are a family of organic compounds with the formula C6H5CnH2n+1.

900001274.name: Mirikizumab
900001274.description: Mirikizumab, sold under the brand name Omvoh, is a monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of ulcerative colitis.

900001402.name: Ocaratuzumab
900001402.description: Ocaratuzumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune disorders.

900001530.name: Petrosifungin
900001530.description: Petrosifungins are cyclodepsipeptides isolated from a sponge-residing Penicillium.

900001658.name: Polypropylene carbonate
900001658.description: Polypropylene carbonate , a copolymer of carbon dioxide and propylene oxide, is a thermoplastic material. Catalysts like zinc glutarate are used in polymerization.

900001914.name: Somatrogon
900001914.description: Somatrogon, sold under the brand name Ngenla, is a medication for the treatment of growth hormone deficiency.
